title: Send to the right person
lesson: Address poisoning: a scammer sends you a 0 AVAX transfer from an address that starts and ends like one you trust, so it appears in your history. Wallets shorten addresses, so the fake looks identical. Copy addresses from the person, never from your history, and check the middle characters.
task: Your tutor has asked for 0.01 AVAX. Choose where to copy the address from, review the transaction, then send it with Core.

en: Hi! Thanks for joining today's crypto safety class 🙏
